args.goal: In the open Savings Calculation window, click Add Custom Reference, enter a 500-character string made of repeated A characters in the reference field, click Save, and stop on the resulting validation or saved state so the application response is recorded.

steps.note: Perform and observe the custom-reference save attempt, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or malformed values.
